description: This PHP source file manages the editing of blocked devices in a parental control system, including form handling, device data retrieval, and UI interactions for setting device block times and days.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the form with device data, sets up event handlers for UI elements, and manages form validation and submission.

methods.name: updateBlockedTimeVisibility
methods.description: Enables or disables block time input fields based on whether the device is set to always block.
